method: Production business transactions using a clone of the installed receiving start in an isolated preview scene. Native inventory, purchase and contract methods; actual supplier callback and explicitly simulated offsite shipment callback. No original scene objects, stock or assets are mutated. Does not certify physical driving, trailer support, road motion or browser interaction.

checks.name: opening physical capital
checks.expectation: Four independent opening pallets total 172 cases, $10,000 opening cash and three unaccepted retailer requests, with stable unique lot IDs.

checks.name: initialization is idempotent
checks.expectation: Calling initialization again cannot duplicate the opening pallets, contracts or ledger balance.

checks.name: invalid supplier item
checks.expectation: An unknown item cannot charge cash, reserve delivery capacity or create physical stock.

checks.name: one active retailer request without early payment
checks.expectation: Accepting one request reserves no cash payout; a second request and a repeated unfulfilled action cannot pay or replace it.

checks.name: release accepted order without inventory or payment changes
checks.expectation: An accepted order can be released before dispatch and another accepted. Unknown, unaccepted, completed and shipping orders reject release without changing cash, physical stock or payout.

checks.name: unreceived stock cannot dispatch
checks.expectation: Pallets still in the opening delivery do not qualify as received inventory, even for a matching accepted request.

checks.name: paid queued supplier order is visible and unique
checks.expectation: One paper pallet deducts $560 once and reserves a real road delivery. Its 48 cases appear inbound before spawning; repeat purchases cannot double charge or replace the booking.

checks.name: supplier arrival callback counts physical stock once
checks.expectation: The booked shipment registers one actual new pallet, clears its pending count and retains 144 inbound paper cases. A repeated delivery callback cannot create more cases or charges.

checks.name: FIFO dates and stable lot identity
checks.expectation: Eligible stock is selected by arrival day and then stable lot sequence, even after reversing the backing collection.

checks.name: completed shipment pays and removes its manifest once
checks.expectation: The explicitly simulated offsite callback pays the accepted request once and removes exactly its 48-case manifest. Repeating it cannot duplicate money, shipped cases or the replacement request.

checks.name: owned stock can request another truck without a purchase
checks.expectation: After one completed shipment leaves the truck away, accepting another order for existing stock requests a free empty return. Repeated pickup requests cannot debit cash, create cases or alter the remaining pallets.

measurements.name: purchased cases after free return request

checks.name: insufficient balance leaves orders untouched
checks.expectation: With a fixture balance below the paper pallet price, both availability and purchase reject without creating a debit or delivery.

checks.name: physical pallet capacity rejects another order
checks.expectation: Fourteen real supplier transactions fill the remaining pallet capacity. A nineteenth pallet is rejected even with enough money, preserving the paid stock and case total.

checks.name: unavailable receiving service cannot charge
checks.expectation: If the fixture has no delivery prefab, a rejected booking rolls back its pending state and retains the original cash and physical stock.
